titleHint: Leave the title empty to use the beginning of the body.

transfer.title: Export / import tasks
transfer.exportHint: Saves a JSON file. You can delete or edit entries in a text editor and import it again.
transfer.importHint: Tasks in the file are added as new tasks. Existing tasks are not changed, and sent-session history is not carried over.
transfer.importSkipped_one: {{count}} empty or malformed entry will be skipped.
transfer.importSkipped_other: {{count}} empty or malformed entries will be skipped.
transfer.replaceHint: These tasks are assigned to characters that don't exist on this computer. Pick a character for each one to reassign all of its tasks at once.
transfer.importBlocked: Resolve the task load or save error before importing.

errors.invalid: The file is not valid JSON.
errors.format: This is not an Agent Office task file.
errors.version: This file was made by a newer version of the app.
errors.empty: There are no tasks to import.

autoRun.title: Auto run
autoRun.idle: Runs the {{count}} remaining prerequisites one by one in {{name}}'s terminal. Each task gets a fresh session, and when a turn ends a judge (claude -p) decides what happens next.
autoRun.finished: All tasks in the plan are done. The root task moved to Review.
autoRun.endHint: End and Clear record only remove the run state and its record. Task statuses stay as they are.

reasons.human-input: The terminal has unsubmitted input, so the run did not type over it.
reasons.session-ended: The session of the current task ended.
reasons.send-failed: Could not send the task or the follow-up.
reasons.judge-failed: The judge call failed. Resume to try again.
reasons.followup-limit: Reached the follow-up limit ({{max}}). The judge wanted to send:
reasons.judge-stop: The judge asked for a human.
reasons.task-busy: A ready task is already in progress or in review. Mark it done or move it back to To do, then resume.
reasons.task-changed: The current task changed (deleted, moved back to To do, or reassigned).

blocked.auto-run-root-done: You can't start from a finished task.
blocked.auto-run-no-assignee: Pick an assignee. That character runs the tasks.
blocked.auto-run-observer-off: Turn on Agent observation in Settings. The run needs hooks to know when a turn ends.
blocked.auto-run-foreign-task: A prerequisite is assigned to another character. Assign it to this character or leave it unassigned.
blocked.auto-run-runner-busy: This character has another auto run that is not finished. End it first.

worker.intro: [Auto run] This task is {{index}}/{{total}} of the plan "{{plan}}". It starts in a fresh session, so use the context below.
worker.report: Do only this task. When you finish, end your last reply with a short summary of what you changed and how you verified it. If a human needs to decide something, say so and stop.
